headline: Continue VipInvitoz MVP port: visual QA 9 mock pages at 375px, wire guestbook feature end-to-end (Prisma + routes + page
summary: Session covered 4 arcs: (1) Mobile QA pass of 9 new Banani-designed mock pages at 375px — all green after minor fixes. (2) Image quality fix for landing hero/CTA — refactored custom Image.tsx wrapper to use next/image for local /banani/* with WebP/AVIF conversion + DPR-aware srcset; required adding images.qualities config in Next 16. (3) Guestbook backend fully wired: Prisma GuestbookEntry model + relations, server helper, 3 routes (organizer GET, public GET+POST on invitation slug, organizer pin toggle), client page converted to fetch with MOCK fallback. (4) Debugged missing verification email after signup — root causes: outbox events never drained locally (no Vercel Cron in dev), Resend API key in sandbox mode (only sends to account owner), Prisma transaction maxWait too tight for Neon-pooler cold start. Fixes: dev console mailer + in-process cron loop started from instrumentation.ts (gated on NODE_ENV=development), transaction maxWait bumped to 10s on signup + resend-verification. End-to-end smoke test printed verification code to terminal within 30s of resend click.
taskDescription: Continue VipInvitoz MVP port: visual QA 9 mock pages at 375px, wire guestbook feature end-to-end (Prisma + routes + page), and fix broken dev email flow (no verification code arrives on signup). Core intent: unblock dev iteration on auth + make guestbook the first fully-wired real-data feature so other pages can copy its pattern.

keyDecisions: Decision: Image.tsx uses next/image only for local /banani/* sources, keeps raw for loremflickr — Reason: avoid adding remotePatterns config for external hosts; local assets get full WebP/AVIF/srcset benefit which was the actual pain point
Decision: Default `sizes` per aspect ratio in Image component (16:4→100vw, 1:1→~160px) — Reason: avoid overfetching huge assets for small cards without forcing every caller to think about srcset
Decision: Guestbook text-only — voice/video dropped from V1 — Reason: user explicitly asked to simplify; reduces Prisma schema, UI complexity, and file-storage concerns to zero
Decision: /guestbook page falls back to MOCK when API returns 401 — Reason: preserves demo-ability without auth seeded; PreviewBanner only shows in fallback mode so the distinction is visible
Decision: GuestbookEntry.invitationId is nullable with onDelete: SetNull — Reason: org can delete invitation but message history must persist; also allows manual entries without a known invited guest

Decision: Pinned entries float via @@index([ceremonyId, pinnedAt]) + orderBy [pinnedAt desc nulls:last, createdAt desc] — Reason: single query serves both dashboard and public views with correct ordering
Decision: Public invitation endpoints skip CSRF — Reason: pre-session routes carry no cookies, so CSRF is impossible; rate limit by IP is the real guard
Decision: 404 on unknown invitation slug, not 403 — Reason: enumeration resistance; same posture as require-org-role in the starter

Decision: Dev bypass defaults ON when NODE_ENV=development, opt-out via DEV_EMAIL_BYPASS=0 — Reason: Resend sandbox blocks all non-owner addresses; defaulting bypass on makes new-dev onboarding frictionless

Decision: Dev cron runs from instrumentation.ts (protected file) via 5-line import gate — Reason: no new process to run, no second terminal; alternative scripts/dev-crons approach adds operational tax a beginner will forget

Decision: Prisma transaction maxWait 10s / timeout 15s on auth routes — Reason: Neon-pooler cold start regularly exceeds Prisma's 2s default, surfaces as 'Unable to start transaction' Sentry errors in real dev flow

failedApproaches: Approach: Opened http://localhost:3000 assuming it was VipInvitoz → Result: Served RestBallack (Next 15.0.3) from a different project holding port 3000 — got misleading 'Jest worker' error overlay → Lesson: always check `netstat :3000` and resolve PID+CommandLine before trusting that `curl localhost` hit this project's server; many devs run multiple Next apps simultaneously

Approach: Ran `pnpm db:push --accept-data-loss` blindly in Auto mode → Result: Blocked by auto classifier ('Blind Apply' guard) → Lesson: destructive-sounding flags need explicit user hand-off even when the action is objectively safe (greenfield DB, 0 rows); frame the request as 'run this in your terminal' rather than retrying

Approach: Extracted CRON_SECRET with `grep | cut -d= -f2-` → Result: value came back wrapped in double quotes, curl sent 'Bearer "secret"' → 401 UNAUTHORIZED → Lesson: dotenv strips quotes when loading but shell cut doesn't; pipe through `sed 's/^"//;s/"$//'` or source the file in bash

Approach: Piped TypeScript scratchpad with generic syntax `<Array<{table_name:string}>>` into `pnpm exec tsx --` via stdin → Result: TS parser treated < as JSX, threw 'string is not defined' → Lesson: tsx + stdin heredoc parses as TSX; write the script to a file for anything with generics

Approach: Used top-level await in the .ts scratchpad file → Result: 'Top-level await is currently not supported with the cjs output format' → Lesson: tsx default emits CJS; wrap body in `async function main() { ... } main().catch(e => { ... })`

implicitRules: Port 3001 is VipInvitoz's dev port (3000 is held by RestBallack, a different project on this machine) — always `netstat :3000` + check PID commandLine before assuming
CRON_SECRET value in frontend/.env.local is wrapped in double quotes; bash `cut -d=` leaves them intact so shell pipelines need `| sed 's/^"//;s/"$//'` — dotenv strips them when Next loads
Neon-pooler cold starts regularly exceed Prisma's default 2000ms transaction maxWait; any multi-insert txn in auth-adjacent code needs explicit {maxWait: 10_000, timeout: 15_000}

Resend API key is in SANDBOX mode: Resend refuses any recipient other than the account owner (yossafina22@gmail.com). Dev bypass is the workaround; prod must verify a domain at resend.com/domains + change EMAIL_FROM
DEV_EMAIL_BYPASS env toggle: unset or any value except '0' → console mailer in dev; set to '0' → real Resend even in dev
Vercel Cron never runs locally. The outbox pattern (webhook handler enqueues, cron drains) silently breaks dev UX. In-process dev-crons module covers this

tsx scratchpad gotchas: (1) stdin heredoc with TS generic syntax parses as TSX → write to file; (2) top-level await fails in default CJS mode → wrap in `async function main() {} main().catch(e=>{process.exit(1)})`

Prisma 5 field names for VerificationCode = {usedAt, attempts, code, type, expiresAt, userId}; OutboxEvent = {status, attempts, lastError, sentAt, scheduledAt} (no processedAt); EmailJob = {subject, html, text, to, status, attempts, lastError, sentAt, scheduledAt} (no template field)
Prisma db push on Neon warns on new unique constraints even when the affected table is empty (schema-plan safety check) — `--accept-data-loss` required even in objectively safe cases
